description: For one error (by fingerprint), get the PAYING users it actually hit — the row-level moat answer: which paying customer broke, and how much are they worth. Returns a list sorted by revenue at risk (highest first), each row with your own user id, monthly revenue in cents, and when they last hit the error. Joins the error layer to identity and revenue. Returns only your own identifiers — never emails or names you didn't provide. Use when you need the actual customers, not just the counts from get_error_impact.

limit.description: Max users to return (1–100, default 25), highest revenue-at-risk first.

project.description: The app to read, as a project id from list_projects (e.g. 'proj_3a8f137bccdd4f'). With a workspace key (cd_wk_) this is required unless you've set a default via use_project; with a single-app key it is ignored.

name: get_error_affected_users
title: Get who an error hit and what they pay
